title: Visible bounded request queue
goal: Define and implement truthful queued/running request state across channels
acceptance: Waiting position comes from actual scheduler state
Cancellation and restart behavior are explicit
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
validation: Run affected regressions across the changed boundary and applicable fast checks
Keep human/device acceptance and independent review distinct from fixture results
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback

effort.basis: Estimate added at featurePlans adoption (2026-11-11): Visible bounded request queue with UI and tests; one of three steps of a Large parent. Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 2.25 hours agent; former 1.5-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: 1.5 h/day judged rate (PR #277). Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1.5 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 2.25 h → 1.25 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept. Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (1.25 h); the baseline stays for calibration.
